user.title: GitHub Card
user.description: Adds the GitHub panel to the sidebar (administrators only), to follow your repositories in the GitHub integration, and the GitHub cards to your dashboards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: GitHub Card is already set up.

create_repository.name: Create a repository
create_repository.description: Creates a GitHub repository with the GitHub CLI (gh) and applies its protections, as the panel's New repository tab. Administrators only.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Account or organization; empty: the account gh is signed in with.

homepage.name: Website
homepage.description: Left out: the website template of Settings.

topics.name: Topics
topics.description: Left out: the topics of Settings.

visibility.name: Visibility
visibility.description: Left out: the visibility of Settings.

protect.name: Protections
protect.description: Settings keys (repo_empty_commit, repo_protect_tags, repo_rulesets_from…); missing ones: the defaults of Settings.
